the evolution of an OSS system and community is a coupled process, and the collaboration model is the most critical determinant for the evolution patterns of both system and community.

the evolution pattern of an OSS system is determined by the evolution pattern of the associated community, which in turn is determined by the collaboration model of the community, which is in turn determined by the goal of the project.

the evolution of OSS is a process that involves the evolution of the OSS system and the evolution of the community, and the two evolutions interact and reinforce each other, resulting in the sustainability of the OSS project.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

OSS development is a complex phenomenon, involving not only the evolution process of software system itself, but also the development of the associated community, which in turn affects the evolution of the software system.

The main takeaway from our work is that

OSS communities are the most important factor in the long-term sustainability of OSS development, and that different collaboration models result in different community evolution patterns, which in turn affect the evolution of the OSS system.
OSS development and maintenance is not just a technical issue, but also a social issue.
